text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is here, but...<n>Maruzensky is not.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I see just a flicker of hesitation in<n>Grass Wonder's
eyes, and then<n>she's back to acting her prim,
practiced self.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that all the preparations are<n>complete,
it's about time.

I glance at her feet and notice she<n>has her training
shoes on.
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you change into your racing cleats?
Shouldn't you change into your racing cleats?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: M-my apologies. I'll put them on right<n>away.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Without Maruzensky's footsteps to<n>follow, Grass
Wonder looks unsure<n>where to go.

Even so, the crowd roars—for the<n>gates must open,
and the Arima Kinen<n>must go on.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hello there, Sei. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Decent, I guess? Same old, same old.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So you're in peak condition,<n>then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I should be off as well.
